def kyberDecapsBytesL48–51 ↗#

Kyber-1024 decapsulation of ct under Bob's setup secret key r.kyberSecB.

def kyberDecapsBytes (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (ct : HwBytes) : Option HwBytes := interpretation kyberDecapsSymbol [r.kyberSecB.drop 1, ct]

def GhostAndSemMatchSetupL53–59 ↗#

Agreement between (S, g) and ProtocolSetup r on setup random draws, opaque public terms, and decapsulation under Bob's Kyber prekey.

def GhostAndSemMatchSetup (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) : Prop := (∀ p ∈ setupRandomsAt r, g.σ p.1 p.2 = r.fresh p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t ∈ [r.spkSigTerm, r.pqpkPubTerm, r.pqpkSigTerm], gamma interpretation S g t = r.opaqueBytes t) ∧ ∀ ct, S.kemDecap (r.opaqueBytes r.pqpkPubTerm) ct = (kyberDecapsBytes interpretation r ct).getD []

def ProtocolSetupWFL61–71 ↗#

Well-formedness of ProtocolSetup r: distinct parties, pairwise distinct setup draws of matching lengths, valid opaque key/signature lengths, and embedded Kyber public key consistency.

def ProtocolSetupWF (r : ProtocolSetup) : Prop := r.alice ≠ r.bob ∧ (∀ p ∈ setupRandomsAt r, (r.fresh p.1 p.2).length = p.2) ∧ ((setupRandomsAt r).map fun p => r.fresh p.1 p.2).Nodup ∧ (r.opaqueBytes r.spkSigTerm).length = 64 ∧ (r.opaqueBytes r.pqpkPubTerm).length = 1568 ∧ (r.opaqueBytes r.pqpkSigTerm).length = 64 ∧ r.kyberSecB.length = 3169 ∧ slice r.kyberSecB 1537 1568 = r.opaqueBytes r.pqpkPubTerm

def HonestBundleL73–81 ↗#

Any 1813-byte bundle blob b carries Bob's setup signed prekey, Kyber prekey, signatures, and identity key.

def HonestBundle (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (b : HwBytes) : Prop := b.length = preKeyBundleByteLength → BundleBlob.spkPub b = ecKey (pubBytes interpretation r.spkSecBytes) ∧ BundleBlob.spkSig b = r.opaqueBytes r.spkSigTerm ∧ BundleBlob.kpkPub b = kyberKey (r.opaqueBytes r.pqpkPubTerm) ∧ BundleBlob.kpkSig b = r.opaqueBytes r.pqpkSigTerm ∧ BundleBlob.ikPub b = ecKey (pubBytes interpretation r.ikBSecBytes)

Inner SignalMessage body of a sent whisper or PreKeySignalMessage wire frame.

def sentBody (msg : HwBytes) : Option HwBytes := match msg with | t :: body => if t = wireWhisperTag then some body else (parsePreKeyWire msg).map (·.message) | [] => none

def PqFromHonestL89–96 ↗#

If body decodes as a SignalMessage, its pq_ratchet field matches that of some earlier sent message body in sent.

def PqFromHonest (sent : List HwBytes) (body : HwBytes) : Prop := ∀ m : CryptoGames.LibsignalSession.SignalMessage, CryptoGames.LibsignalSession.SignalMessage.tryFrom protoSignalCodec body = .ok m → ∃ b ∈ sent, ∃ m' : CryptoGames.LibsignalSession.SignalMessage, CryptoGames.LibsignalSession.SignalMessage.tryFrom protoSignalCodec b = .ok m' ∧ m'.pqRatchet = m.pqRatchet

def BundleSignedKeysMatch (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (b : HwBytes) (spk spkSig pqpk pqpkSig : DY.Bytes) : Prop := let γ := gamma interpretation S g b.length = preKeyBundleByteLength ∧ BundleBlob.spkPub b = ecKey (γ spk) ∧ BundleBlob.spkSig b = γ spkSig ∧ BundleBlob.kpkPub b = kyberKey (γ pqpk) ∧ BundleBlob.kpkSig b = γ pqpkSig

def PreKeyBundleLayoutMatches (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (b : HwBytes) : List DY.Bytes → Prop | [spk, spkSig, pqpk, pqpkSig] => BundleSignedKeysMatch interpretation S g b spk spkSig pqpk pqpkSig ∧ BundleBlob.hasOpkByte b = some 0#8 | [spk, spkSig, pqpk, pqpkSig, opk] => BundleSignedKeysMatch interpretation S g b spk spkSig pqpk pqpkSig ∧ BundleBlob.hasOpkByte b = some 1#8 ∧ BundleBlob.opkPub b = ecKey (gamma interpretation S g opk) | _ => False

def SendMatchesL121–130 ↗#

Alice's sent PreKeySignalMessage b matches [ek, ct, msg] under her active initIds.

def SendMatches (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (initIds : Option BundlePreKeyIds) (b : HwBytes) : List DY.Bytes → Prop | [ek, ct, msg] => let γ := gamma interpretation S g ∃ preKeyId spkId kpkId, initIds = some (preKeyId, spkId, kpkId) ∧ b = preKeyWire preKeyId spkId kpkId r.regIdA (ecKey (pubBytes interpretation r.ikASecBytes)) (γ ek) (γ ct) (γ msg) | _ => False

def OpkNamedL132–137 ↗#

One-time prekey header check on b: requires preKeyId = some r.opkId and r.withOpk = true when used = true, and preKeyId = none when used = false.

def OpkNamed (r : ProtocolSetup) (b : HwBytes) (used : Bool) : Prop := ∃ p, parsePreKeyWire b = some p ∧ if used then p.preKeyId = some r.opkId ∧ r.withOpk = true else p.preKeyId = none

def PreKeyRecvMatchesL139–153 ↗#

Bob's received PreKeySignalMessage b matches [ek, ct, msg] and Bob's setup key IDs.

def PreKeyRecvMatches (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (b : HwBytes) : List DY.Bytes → Prop | [ek, ct, msg] => let γ := gamma interpretation S g ∃ p, parsePreKeyWire b = some p ∧ p.baseKey.take 33 = ecKey (γ ek) ∧ p.kyberCiphertext = some (kyberKey (γ ct)) ∧ p.message = γ msg ∧ p.version = 4 ∧ p.signedPreKeyId = r.spkId ∧ p.kyberPreKeyId = some r.kpkId ∧ p.identityKey.take 33 = ecKey (pubBytes interpretation r.ikASecBytes) ∧ (∃ used, OpkNamed r b used) | _ => False

def PreKeyRecvOpkMatchesL155–159 ↗#

def PreKeyRecvOpkMatches (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (b : HwBytes) : List DY.Bytes → Prop | [ek, ct, msg] => PreKeyRecvMatches interpretation r S g b [ek, ct, msg] ∧ OpkNamed r b false | [ek, ct, msg, _opk] => PreKeyRecvMatches interpretation r S g b [ek, ct, msg] ∧ OpkNamed r b true | _ => False

def BytesMatchEntryL161–182 ↗#

Concrete bytes b of kind k match observable model entry v according to v.layout.

def BytesMatchEntry (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (k : VisEventKind) (b : HwBytes) (v : VisEntry) (initIds : Option BundlePreKeyIds := none) : Prop := k = v.kind ∧ let γ := gamma interpretation S g match v.layout with | .single => v.terms.map γ = [b] | .whisper => ∃ t, v.terms = [t] ∧ b = wireWhisperTag :: γ t | .bundle => PreKeyBundleLayoutMatches interpretation S g b v.terms | .preKeySend => SendMatches interpretation r S g initIds b v.terms | .preKeyRecv => PreKeyRecvOpkMatches interpretation r S g b v.terms | .preKeyInner eks => ∃ t p, v.terms = [t] ∧ parsePreKeyWire b = some p ∧ p.version = 4 ∧ p.identityKey.take 33 = ecKey (pubBytes interpretation (secretBytes r 0)) ∧ (∃ ek ∈ eks, p.baseKey.take 33 = ecKey (γ ek)) ∧ p.message = γ t | .fresh n => b.length = n | .kyberCoin j => b.length = 4 ∧ ∃ t, v.terms = [t] ∧ (γ t).length = 32 ∧ b.head? = (γ t)[j]? | .unconstrained => True | .leakPq pq => if pq then b = r.kyberSecB else v.terms.map γ = [b] | .leakRecord => ∃ t, v.terms = [t] ∧ (b = γ t ∨ b = clamp (γ t))

def GhostWFL184–196 ↗#

Ghost well-formedness on vis: nonzero rng draws match their requested byte lengths, and g.addr carries serialized (alice, bob) protocol addresses on preKeySend and [] on whisper.

def GhostWF (g : Ghost) (vis : List VisEntry) : Prop := (∀ v ∈ vis, v.kind = .rng → ∀ ts n, n ≠ 0 → randTerm ts n ∈ v.terms → (g.σ ts n).length = n) ∧ (∀ t, g.addr t = [] ∨ g.addr t = Cli.serializeAddresses ⟨Cli.aliceUuid, 1⟩ ⟨Cli.bobUuid, 1⟩) ∧ (∀ v ∈ vis, v.kind = .send → (v.layout = .preKeySend → ∀ ek ct msg pm, v.terms = [ek, ct, msg] → parseTrSignalMsg msg = some pm → g.addr pm.wire = Cli.serializeAddresses ⟨Cli.aliceUuid, 1⟩ ⟨Cli.bobUuid, 1⟩) ∧ (v.layout = .whisper → ∀ msg pm, v.terms = [msg] → parseTrSignalMsg msg = some pm → g.addr pm.wire = []))

DY.Spqr.SendMsg.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.Spqr.RecvState.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.Spqr.RecvKey.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.Spqr.ChainKey.SubF).isSome

abbrev FaithfulWireMacAndL205–210 ↗#

abbrev FaithfulWireMacAnd (γ : DY.Bytes → HwBytes) (msg : TRSignalMsg) (raw : HwBytes) (P : Prop) : Prop := γ msg.wire = raw.take (raw.length - 8) ∧ γ msg.mac = raw.drop (raw.length - 8) ∧ spqrHeaded msg.mac = false ∧ P

abbrev FaithfulDecodedSignalMsgL212–217 ↗#

abbrev FaithfulDecodedSignalMsg (γ : DY.Bytes → HwBytes) (msg : TRSignalMsg) (m : CryptoGames.LibsignalSession.SignalMessage) : Prop := γ msg.ciphertext = m.ciphertext ∧ γ msg.ratchetKey = m.senderRatchetKey.bytes.toList ∧ γ msg.pqRatchet = m.pqRatchet ∧ msg.counter.toNat = m.counter.toNat ∧ msg.version.toNat = m.messageVersion.toNat

abbrev FaithfulSignalMsgFieldsL219–221 ↗#

abbrev FaithfulSignalMsgFields (γ : DY.Bytes → HwBytes) (msg : TRSignalMsg) (raw : HwBytes) (m : CryptoGames.LibsignalSession.SignalMessage) : Prop := FaithfulWireMacAnd γ msg raw (FaithfulDecodedSignalMsg γ msg m)

def recvRepresentationsOnL223–234 ↗#

Attacker-known symbolic terms on tr concretizing to SignalMessage body b with matching decoded fields and a non-SPQR-headed MAC.

def recvRepresentationsOn (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (b : HwBytes) : Set DY.Bytes := let γ := gamma interpretation S g {t | t.AttackerKnows tr ∧ γ t = b ∧ (parseTrSignalMsg t).isSome = true ∧ ∀ msg, parseTrSignalMsg t = some msg → FaithfulWireMacAnd γ msg b (∀ m : CryptoGames.LibsignalSession.SignalMessage, CryptoGames.LibsignalSession.SignalMessage.tryFrom protoSignalCodec b = .ok m → FaithfulDecodedSignalMsg γ msg m)}

structure PreKeyRepL236–240 ↗#

structure PreKeyRep where ek : DY.Bytes ct : DY.Bytes msg : DY.Bytes

def FaithfulInnerL242–245 ↗#

def FaithfulInner (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (t : DY.Bytes) (p : PreKeyFields) : Prop := ∃ msg, parseTrSignalMsg t = some msg ∧ FaithfulSignalMsgFields (gamma interpretation S g) msg p.message p.inner

def preKeyRepresentationsOnL247–252 ↗#

Attacker-known PreKeyRep triples on tr matching received PreKeySignalMessage bytes b.

def preKeyRepresentationsOn (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (b : HwBytes) : Set PreKeyRep := {x | x.ek.AttackerKnows tr ∧ x.ct.AttackerKnows tr ∧ x.msg.AttackerKnows tr ∧ PreKeyRecvMatches interpretation r S g b [x.ek, x.ct, x.msg] ∧ ∃ p, parsePreKeyWire b = some p ∧ FaithfulInner interpretation S g x.msg p}

def bobDoneBaseKeysL254–258 ↗#

def bobDoneBaseKeys (tr : ExecTrace) : List DY.Bytes := (List.range tr.length).filterMap fun i => match tr.getEventAt PQXDHEvent i with | some (.BobDone _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ek _ _) => some ek | _ => none

def assumedInjectiveL260–268 ↗#

Non-opaque term heads treated as collision-resistant in MemoCollisionOn: nonzero-size Random, dhPk, dh, kdfExtract, symEnc, trunc8, and 32-byte-entropy Encap / SharedSecret.

def assumedInjective (t : DY.Bytes) : Bool := ((t.view? DY.Random.Random).map (·.size != 0)).getD false || (t.view? DY.DiffieHellman.DhPk.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.DiffieHellman.Dh.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.KdfExtract.KdfExtract.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.SymEnc.Enc.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.Trunc.Trunc8.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.PQKem.Encap.SubF).isSome || (t.view? DY.PQKem.SharedSecret.SubF).isSome

def honestKeysOf : ExecTrace → List Step → List DY.Bytes | _, [] => [] | tr, s :: ss => (s.publishedSpqrKey? tr).toList ++ honestKeysOf (s.next tr) ss

Candidate SPQR salts (zeroKey plus all SPQR keys published by honest encrypts in ss).

def availableStatesL278–279 ↗#

def availableStates (r : ProtocolSetup) (tr : ExecTrace) : List TRState := (storedStates r tr).map (·.state)

def ownKeysL281–284 ↗#

Receiver's own RecvKey terms for msg.pqRatchet across stored states of matching role.

def ownKeys (r : ProtocolSetup) (tr : ExecTrace) (st : TRState) (msg : TRSignalMsg) : List DY.Bytes := ((availableStates r tr).filter (·.initiator == st.initiator)).map fun st' => ({st := st'.spqr, msg := msg.pqRatchet} : DY.Spqr.RecvKey.SubF DY.Bytes).pack

def storedSecretsL286–288 ↗#

def storedSecrets (tr : ExecTrace) : List DY.Bytes := (List.range tr.length).filterMap fun i => (tr.getLocalStateAt PQXDH.PQXDHState i).map serialize

def principalTermsL290–292 ↗#

def principalTerms (r : ProtocolSetup) (tr : ExecTrace) (vis : List VisEntry) : List DY.Bytes := (vis.filter (·.kind == .send)).flatMap (·.terms) ++ (storedStates r tr).map (fun ls => serialize ls) ++ storedSecrets tr

def plaintextTermsL294–295 ↗#

def plaintextTerms (vis : List VisEntry) : List DY.Bytes := (vis.filter (·.kind == .pt)).flatMap (·.terms)

def prefixTermsL297–298 ↗#

def prefixTerms (r : ProtocolSetup) (tr : ExecTrace) (vis : List VisEntry) : List DY.Bytes := principalTerms r tr vis ++ plaintextTerms vis

def MemoCollisionOnL300–315 ↗#

Non-opaque subterm collision between newTerms and prefixTerms r tr vis ++ newTerms: two memoized subterms with distinct shapes (at least one headed by assumedInjective) map to identical bytes, with plaintext atoms colliding only against attacker-unknown injective terms.

def MemoCollisionOn (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (known : DY.Bytes → Prop) (tr : ExecTrace) (vis : List VisEntry) (newTerms : List DY.Bytes) (newPts : List DY.Bytes) : Prop := let memo := fun t => (gamma' interpretation S g t).memo let new := newTerms.flatMap memo let terms := ((prefixTerms r tr vis).flatMap memo) ++ new let pts := plaintextTerms vis ++ newPts ∃ x₁ ∈ new, ∃ x₂ ∈ terms, x₁.2.1 ≠ x₂.2.1 ∧ (assumedInjective x₁.1 ∨ assumedInjective x₂.1) ∧ (x₁.1 ∈ pts → x₂.1 ∉ pts ∧ assumedInjective x₂.1 ∧ ¬ known x₂.1) ∧ (x₂.1 ∈ pts → x₁.1 ∉ pts ∧ assumedInjective x₁.1 ∧ ¬ known x₁.1) ∧ x₁.2.2 = x₂.2.2

structure TrialCtxL317–323 ↗#

Context of a single receiver decryption trial.

structure TrialCtx where peerIk : DY.Bytes myIk : DY.Bytes extra : List DY.Bytes ownSalts : List DY.Bytes seed? : Option DY.Bytes

def whisperTrialsL325–357 ↗#

Receiver decryption trials across all stored TRState snapshots and cached skipped seeds on tr for msg.

def whisperTrials (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (msg : TRSignalMsg) : List TrialCtx := if msg.version = messageVersion then let γ := gamma interpretation S g (availableStates r tr).flatMap fun st => let own := ownKeys r tr st msg let chains := (st.toDRState.recv.filter fun c => decide (γ c.ratchetKey = γ msg.ratchetKey)) ++ match findRecvChain st.recv msg.ratchetKey, recvHalfStep st.toDRState msg.ratchetKey with | none, some (_, c) => [c] | _, _ => [] (chains.map fun c => match consumeMessageKey c msg.counter with | none => { peerIk := st.peerIk, myIk := st.myIk, extra := [c.chainKey], ownSalts := [], seed? := none } | some (seed, c') => { peerIk := st.peerIk, myIk := st.myIk, extra := [c.chainKey, c'.chainKey] ++ skippedSeeds c msg.counter, ownSalts := own, seed? := some seed }) ++ (List.range tr.length).filterMap fun i => match tr.getEventAt TripleRatchet.TREvent i with | some (.SkippedKeyStored s pk n seed _ _) => if (TripleRatchet.findRecvChain st.toDRState.recv pk).isSome ∧ γ pk = γ msg.ratchetKey ∧ n = msg.counter then some { peerIk := st.peerIk, myIk := st.myIk, extra := [], ownSalts := if st.sessionInfo s.me = s then own else [], seed? := some seed } else none | _ => none else []

def bobTrialsL359–402 ↗#

Bob's initial decryption trial when starting a session from pre-key message p (representation x, inner message msg) on tr.

def bobTrials (r : ProtocolSetup) (tr : ExecTrace) (p : PreKeyFields) (x : PreKeyRep) (msg : TRSignalMsg) : List TrialCtx := match (match p.preKeyId with | none => some none | some id => if r.withOpk && id == r.opkId then some (some r.opkSecTerm) else none) with | none => [] | some opk => let ekBytes := ((p.baseKey.take 33).drop 1).map BitVec.toNat let rkBytes := p.inner.senderRatchetKey.bytes.toList.map BitVec.toNat if !(decide (DY.X25519.leValue ekBytes < DY.X25519.p25519) && !DY.X25519.isLowOrderKey ekBytes && !PQXDH.x25519LowOrder x.ek && decide (msg.version = messageVersion) && !DY.X25519.isLowOrderKey rkBytes && !TripleRatchet.x25519LowOrder msg.ratchetKey && opk.all fun s => !PQXDH.opkUsedB tr r.bob (DY.DiffieHellman.dhPk s)) then [] else let ikA := r.ikAPubTerm let spk := r.spkSecTerm let pqsk := r.pqskSecTerm let ss := (errToOption (PQKem.kemDecap pqsk x.ct)).getD (PQKem.kemRejKey pqsk x.ct) let keys := pqxdhKdf (pqxdhIkm (agree ikA spk) (agree x.ek r.ikBSecTerm) (agree x.ek spk) (opk.map (agree x.ek ·)) ss) let c : RecvChain := { ratchetKey := msg.ratchetKey, chainKey := (createChain keys.rk msg.ratchetKey spk).2, index := 0, rIdx := 2 } let peerIk := serializedIk ikA let myIk := serializedIk r.ikBPubTerm match consumeMessageKey c msg.counter with | none => [{ peerIk, myIk, extra := [keys.rk, keys.ck, keys.pqr, c.chainKey], ownSalts := [], seed? := none }] | some (seed, c') => let own := ((DY.Spqr.spqrRecv (DY.Spqr.spqrInit keys.pqr TripleRatchet.spqrB2A) msg.pqRatchet (preKeySpqrIndex p)).map (·.2)).toList [{ peerIk, myIk, extra := [keys.rk, keys.ck, keys.pqr, c.chainKey, c'.chainKey] ++ skippedSeeds c msg.counter, ownSalts := own, seed? := some seed }]

def trialTermsL404–413 ↗#

def trialTerms (salts : List DY.Bytes) (msg : TRSignalMsg) (ctx : TrialCtx) : List DY.Bytes := ctx.extra ++ match ctx.seed? with | none => [] | some seed => salts.flatMap fun salt => let mk := trMsgKeys salt seed [mk.cipherKey, mk.macKey, mk.iv, computeMac mk.macKey ctx.peerIk ctx.myIk msg.wire] ++ (DY.SymEnc.symDec mk.cipherKey mk.iv msg.ciphertext).toList

def UnknownSeedMacGuessL415–428 ↗#

A receiver trial matches msg.mac using an own SPQR salt k and an attacker-unknown ratchet seed whose derived message keys differ from every honest salt in honest.

def UnknownSeedMacGuess (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (known : DY.Bytes → Prop) (honest : List DY.Bytes) (msg : TRSignalMsg) (ctxs : List TrialCtx) : Prop := let γ := gamma interpretation S g ∃ ctx ∈ ctxs, ∃ seed, ctx.seed? = some seed ∧ ∃ k ∈ ctx.ownSalts, let mk := trMsgKeys k seed γ (computeMac mk.macKey ctx.peerIk ctx.myIk msg.wire) = γ msg.mac ∧ ¬ known seed ∧ ∀ salt ∈ honest, let hmk := trMsgKeys salt seed (γ hmk.cipherKey, γ hmk.macKey, γ hmk.iv) ≠ (γ mk.cipherKey, γ mk.macKey, γ mk.iv)

def TruncatedMacSeedCollision (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (honest : List DY.Bytes) (msg : TRSignalMsg) (ctxs : List TrialCtx) : Prop := let γ := gamma interpretation S g ∃ ctx ∈ ctxs, ∃ seed, ctx.seed? = some seed ∧ ∃ k ∈ ctx.ownSalts, let mk := trMsgKeys k seed γ (computeMac mk.macKey ctx.peerIk ctx.myIk msg.wire) = γ msg.mac ∧ ∃ ctx₀ ∈ ctxs, ∃ seed₀, ctx₀.seed? = some seed₀ ∧ γ seed ≠ γ seed₀ ∧ ((∃ salt₀ ∈ ctx₀.ownSalts ++ honest, γ (computeMac (trMsgKeys salt₀ seed₀).macKey ctx₀.peerIk ctx₀.myIk msg.wire) = γ msg.mac) ∨ ∃ peerIk₀ myIk₀ salt₀ w, msg.mac = computeMac (trMsgKeys salt₀ seed₀).macKey peerIk₀ myIk₀ w ∧ γ w = γ msg.wire)

def MacTagForgeryOrCollision (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (known : DY.Bytes → Prop) (honest : List DY.Bytes) (msg : TRSignalMsg) (ctxs : List TrialCtx) : Prop := UnknownSeedMacGuess interpretation S g known honest msg ctxs ∨ TruncatedMacSeedCollision interpretation S g honest msg ctxs

def RecvCollisionOnL453–463 ↗#

Receive-path collision on symbolic SignalMessage term t across whisperTrials.

def RecvCollisionOn (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (vis : List VisEntry) (salts : List DY.Bytes) (t : DY.Bytes) : Prop := let known := fun u : DY.Bytes => u.AttackerKnows tr match parseTrSignalMsg t with | none => MemoCollisionOn interpretation r S g known tr vis [t] [] | some msg => let ctxs := whisperTrials interpretation r S g tr msg MemoCollisionOn interpretation r S g known tr vis (t :: ctxs.flatMap (trialTerms salts msg)) [] ∨ MacTagForgeryOrCollision interpretation S g known salts msg ctxs

def storedRatchetKeys (r : ProtocolSetup) (tr : ExecTrace) (msg : TRSignalMsg) : List DY.Bytes := ((availableStates r tr).flatMap fun st => st.toDRState.recv.map (·.ratchetKey)) ++ (List.range tr.length).filterMap fun i => match tr.getEventAt TripleRatchet.TREvent i with | some (.SkippedKeyStored _ pk n _ _ _) => if ((availableStates r tr).any fun st => (TripleRatchet.findRecvChain st.toDRState.recv pk).isSome) ∧ n = msg.counter then some pk else none | _ => none

def ReselectsToL476–478 ↗#

def ReselectsTo (msg msg' : TRSignalMsg) (rk : DY.Bytes) : Prop := msg'.ratchetKey = rk ∧ msg'.version = msg.version ∧ msg'.counter = msg.counter ∧ msg'.ciphertext = msg.ciphertext ∧ msg'.pqRatchet = msg.pqRatchet

def ReselectCollisionOn (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (vis : List VisEntry) (salts : List DY.Bytes) (t : DY.Bytes) : Prop := let γ := gamma interpretation S g ∃ msg, parseTrSignalMsg t = some msg ∧ ∃ rk ∈ storedRatchetKeys r tr msg, γ rk = γ msg.ratchetKey ∧ rk ≠ msg.ratchetKey ∧ (∃ t' ∈ recvRepresentationsOn interpretation S g tr (γ t), ∃ msg', parseTrSignalMsg t' = some msg' ∧ ReselectsTo msg msg' rk) ∧ ∀ t' ∈ recvRepresentationsOn interpretation S g tr (γ t), ∀ msg', parseTrSignalMsg t' = some msg' → ReselectsTo msg msg' rk → RecvCollisionOn interpretation r S g tr vis salts t'

def BobSessionStartCollidesOrImplicitRejectsOn (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (vis : List VisEntry) (salts : List DY.Bytes) (p : PreKeyFields) (x : PreKeyRep) : Prop := let known := fun u : DY.Bytes => u.AttackerKnows tr match parseTrSignalMsg x.msg with | none => MemoCollisionOn interpretation r S g known tr vis [x.ek, x.ct, x.msg] [] | some msg => let ctxs := bobTrials r tr p x msg MemoCollisionOn interpretation r S g known tr vis ([x.ek, x.ct, x.msg] ++ ctxs.flatMap (trialTerms salts msg)) [] ∨ MacTagForgeryOrCollision interpretation S g known salts msg ctxs

def KyberMismatchL511–516 ↗#

Kyber-1024 correctness failure on p.kyberCiphertext: some 32-byte entropy e encapsulates to (ct, ss) under Bob's public key while decapsulation under r.kyberSecB does not return ss.

def KyberMismatch (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (p : PreKeyFields) : Prop := ∃ e ct ss, e.length = 32 ∧ p.kyberCiphertext = some (kyberKey ct) ∧ kyberEncapsBytes interpretation r e = some (ct, ss) ∧ kyberDecapsBytes interpretation r ct ≠ some ss

def ReadsFaithfully (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (v : VisEntry) (b : HwBytes) : Prop := match v.layout, v.terms, b with | .whisper, [t], _ :: body => t ∈ recvRepresentationsOn interpretation S g tr body | .preKeyInner _, [t], b => ∀ p, parsePreKeyWire b = some p → t ∈ recvRepresentationsOn interpretation S g tr p.message | .preKeyRecv, ek :: ct :: msg :: _, b => ⟨ek, ct, msg⟩ ∈ preKeyRepresentationsOn interpretation r S g tr b | _, _, _ => True

On a received PreKeySignalMessage, messageDecrypt / messageDecryptSkipped is taken iff its base key matches an earlier BobDone (promote_matching_session), and bobStart iff it does not.

def PathFaithfulAt (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (s : Step) (b : HwBytes) : Prop := ∀ p, parsePreKeyWire b = some p → let known := ∃ ek ∈ bobDoneBaseKeys tr, ecKey (gamma interpretation S g ek) = p.baseKey.take 33 match s with | .messageDecrypt .. | .messageDecryptSkipped .. => known | .bobStart .. => ¬ known | _ => True

drs matches consecutive non-empty slices of a prefix of coins.

def DrawsMatch (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (drs : List VisEntry) (coins : HwBytes) : Prop := ∃ pieces : List HwBytes, (∀ p ∈ pieces, p ≠ []) ∧ pieces.flatten <+: coins ∧ List.Forall₂ (fun p v => BytesMatchEntry interpretation r S g .rng p v) pieces drs

def OutputsMatch (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (ev : RunEvent) (outs : List VisEntry) (initIds : Option BundlePreKeyIds := none) : Prop := match ev.exit, ev.cmd with | some (0, out), .send _ => ∃ v, outs = [v] ∧ BytesMatchEntry interpretation r S g .send out v initIds | some (0, out), .recv _ => ∃ v, outs = [v] ∧ BytesMatchEntry interpretation r S g .accept out v | _, _ => outs = []

def RunMatchesL588–600 ↗#

Party step s from tr explains exit-0 CLI run event ev with visible entries vis.

def RunMatches (interpretation : ExternInterpretation) (r : ProtocolSetup) (S : OpaqueSymbolSemantics) (g : Ghost) (tr : ExecTrace) (s : Step) (ev : RunEvent) (vis : List VisEntry) (initIds : Option BundlePreKeyIds := none) : Prop := s.cls = .party ∧ s.party? = some ev.party ∧ s.FitsCmd ev.cmd ∧ s.MatchesSetupPeer r ∧ s.ok tr = true ∧ (∃ out, ev.exit = some (0, out)) ∧ vis = stepView s tr (runWrapped ev) ∧ ∃ inp drs outs, vis = inp :: (drs ++ outs) ∧ BytesMatchEntry interpretation r S g (inputKind ev) ev.input inp ∧ DrawsMatch interpretation r S g drs ev.coins ∧ OutputsMatch interpretation r S g ev outs initIds ∧ ReadsFaithfully interpretation r S g tr inp ev.input ∧ PathFaithfulAt interpretation S g tr s ev.input
